name: project-base
description: Full-stack monorepo template: NestJS, Next.js, and Docker-based PostgreSQL.

scripts.compose: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml --env-file infrastructure/.env.backend --env-file infrastructure/.env.frontend --env-file infrastructure/.env.database
scripts.docker:reset: npm run compose -- down -v && npm run compose -- up --build
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace worker-proxy-agent-ia
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace worker-proxy-agent-ia
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace worker-proxy-agent-ia
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace worker-proxy-agent-ia && npm run test:sdd
